correctness.rationale: The rank-3 Fano independence complex has full K7 one-skeleton, 28 noncollinear triangles, reduced Euler characteristic −1+7−21+28=13; missing-line loops fill using any outside vertex, hence its only reduced integral homology is H2=Z^13. The Heawood incidence independence complex has full face counts (1,14,70,154,147,56,14,2) and mod2 augmented boundary ranks (1,13,57,97,44,12,2); these bound rational Betti numbers, and Euler characteristic forces H̃3(Q)=Q^6 only. Exact full-group oriented fixed-face character comparison under GL(3,2), 168 elements, yields Fano (13,−3,1,1,−1,−1), Heawood (6,−2,0,2,−1,−1), Sylow-seven augmentation (7,−1,1,−1,0,0). Independently checked the class-weighted identity and inner products (Heawood norm=2,Sylow norm=1, cross=0). Maschke and rational character determination give the abstract direct-sum, not a canonical geometric splitting. Inspected full finite verifier source for all 168 elements and exact mod2 ranks; no logs taken as independent proof.
